test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The new owners hired a lot of new servers.

options.text: A lot of new servers were hired by the new owners.
A lot of new servers are being hired by the new owners.
A lot of new servers are hired by the new owners.
A lot of new servers had been hired by the new owners.

solution:
The correct answer is: **A lot of new servers were hired by the new owners.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the simple past tense.
 
• The simple past tense in the active voice has the following structure: Subject + V2+ object__
 
• The simple past tense in the passive voice has the following structure: __Object+ was/were V3+ by + subject__
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Active voice - Rohan bought a pencil.
 
• Passive voice - A pencil was bought by Rohan..
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Passive Voice: *A lot of new servers were hired by the new owners.*
